changes.result: Checkout now checks the earliest queue ticket before service and resets service progress when that head is still walking to checkout; later queued customers cannot be overtaken. Added a regression test with ticket 1 to-checkout and ticket 2 queued.

Added queued -> packing -> leaving lifecycle with a 320ms packing delay, checkout-packing and checkout-pack feedback, cashPile deposit only after packing, and preserved wallet separation plus leave/re-enter collection. Added deterministic lifecycle and collection assertions.
Restart now clears the stale toast and hides settlement presentation immediately through resetRoundPresentation; simulation restart feedback reset and presentation helper tests cover the behavior.

Added pure responsive sizing for all required portrait and landscape viewports while retaining 540x960 Phaser world coordinates. Portrait frames shrink to available chrome; landscape uses a side panel so HUD and settlement buttons remain visible. Captured viewport and settlement smoke evidence.

Replaced abstract station circles with original procedural beach, sea, sand, paths, station pads, fish/checkout/construction/upgrade icons, customer/player silhouettes, product stacks, cash coins, progress bars, queue slots, and semantic local feedback labels. No third-party or first-version source/assets were copied.
Added window-level immediate keyboard state captured before Phaser scene readiness and merged it with Phaser keyboard state; development runtime smoke observed immediate ArrowUp movement.
